atlases.spec:
Square atlas, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows, 9 equally-sized cells. Row 1: (1) whole bald face base including forehead, cheeks and chin, no ears, no eyes, no brows, no mouth, no nose, no hair, no blush; use the same full rounded face silhouette and head tilt as target, peach flat skin with restrained contour shadows; (2) screen-left ear alone, finish entire ear; (3) screen-right ear alone.
Row 2: (4) REAR hair mass: full spiky orange silhouette surrounding the head, with full opaque orange cap completing occluded scalp, no face or ears, no front bang detail. (5) center FRONT BANGS, orange tapered fluffy locks covering forehead center, isolated hair locks with extended hidden root. (6) screen-left front and side hair locks, isolated tuft group with roots completed.
Row 3: (7) screen-right front and side hair locks, isolated tuft group with roots completed; (8) upright top cowlick tuft group, orange, hidden root completed; (9) neck alone, peach skin extending up into the head and down inside collar, no clothing.
Only these 9 components. Hair parts are SOLID orange and no holes cut out for the face.

Portrait atlas, exactly 2 columns by 7 rows, 14 equally-sized cells. All paired eye components are from the target's screen-left eye in left column and screen-right eye in right column, retaining their original angle. Each drawing is large, clearly isolated, one piece per cell.
Row 1: left eye WHITE and right eye WHITE, each ONLY opaque ivory eye white shape with subtle pale shadow, NO iris, pupil, lashes or outline.
Row 2: left IRIS and right IRIS, each full isolated brown/amber oval iris, darker brown pupil and painted amber/white highlights included, NO eye white, no eyelid, no skin.
Row 3: left UPPER EYELID/LASH and right UPPER EYELID/LASH, only the tapered warm dark brown arcing upper lash stroke and tiny lid line, transparent everywhere else, NO white or iris.
Row 4: left LOWER EYELID outline and right LOWER EYELID outline, only the thin warm brown lower curve, no white or iris or skin.
Row 5: left eyebrow and right eyebrow, isolated orange-brown tapered eyebrows, no skin.
Row 6: left cheek blush and right cheek blush, faint peach blush with fine short terracotta hand-drawn hatch strokes, transparent softly faded surroundings, no skin silhouette or facial features.
Row 7: left fully CLOSED EYE and right fully CLOSED EYE, friendly curved tapering eyelash/eyelid strokes for blink, transparent elsewhere, no surrounding skin.
Keep eyes lively and faithful to reference rather than round generic emoji eyes.

Square atlas, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows, 9 equally sized cells. All clothes shown at original tilt and pose. Row 1: (1) lowered yellow HOOD BACK, complete rounded hollow hood behind neck, yellow fabric with ochre interior, no head/face/hair; (2) whole RAINCOAT TORSO WITHOUT SLEEVES, full original yellow coat length and flared hem, front seam and pockets, finished shoulder side seams underneath removed sleeves, no hood, no hands, NO buttons or crow emblem, no collar; (3) screen-left front collar fold alone, yellow ochre shaded wedge, complete inner overlap.
Row 2: (4) screen-right front collar fold alone; (5) screen-left yellow sleeve from shoulder to gathered cuff, complete shoulder root, original bent pose; (6) screen-right yellow sleeve from shoulder to gathered cuff, complete shoulder root, original pose.
Row 3: (7) screen-left coat lower hem flap, yellow triangular cloth piece suitable for independent cloth swing; (8) screen-right coat lower hem flap; (9) black shorts full waistband and two legs, finish the upper portion normally hidden by coat.
Each requested garment isolated and opaque, NO human anatomy, no head or hands.

Portrait atlas, exactly 2 columns by 4 rows, 8 equally sized cells. Always screen-left part in left column and screen-right in right column, retain target's original viewing angle and standing pose.
Row 1: screen-left HAND and screen-right HAND, the original softly curled hands that pinch coat hem, complete all finger contours and extend peach wrist far enough inside cuff, isolated skin only, no fabric.
Row 2: screen-left BARE LEG and screen-right BARE LEG, cute short peach skin legs, complete rounded upper thigh underneath shorts and complete shins down inside boots, no shorts or boots; original standing stance, restrained shadow and hand-drawn contour.
Row 3: screen-left yellow RAIN BOOT and screen-right yellow RAIN BOOT, original yellow rain boots with orange soles, complete boot top and opening, no leg inside, no ground shadow.
Row 4: screen-left BARE ARM and screen-right BARE ARM, shoulder through elbow and forearm, softly bent matching reference hidden sleeve pose, smooth peach skin, no hands, no clothing, complete both ends as overlap reserves.
Exactly eight pieces, no duplicate body parts or extra objects.

Square atlas, exactly 2 columns by 4 rows, 8 equally sized cells. Row 1: (1) smile mouth INTERIOR CAVITY, full deep warm reddish-brown silhouette of the same cheerful open smile, no teeth or tongue, no outer skin; (2) UPPER TEETH, one smooth ivory white upper tooth band with very thin warm contour matching the reference open smile, no mouth cavity or skin.
Row 2: (3) TONGUE, soft salmon pink lower inside-mouth shape with restrained warm shade, no mouth cavity or teeth; (4) MOUTH OUTLINE ONLY, warm dark red-brown full thin tapered open smile contour with heavier corner accents, the inside completely transparent, no skin, teeth or tongue.
Row 3: (5) NOSE, tiny warm terracotta hand-drawn nostril/shadow strokes, no skin disk; (6) closed smiling MOUTH LINE, single gently curved thin warm brown stroke for resting smile with tiny corner accents, no skin.
Row 4: (7) black CROW EMBLEM matching the little black bird silhouette on raincoat, isolated symbol; (8) one orange RAINCOAT BUTTON with thin russet contour and small painterly highlight, isolated round button.
Exactly eight parts, no other facial features. The first four mouth layers must have corresponding compatible shapes so they combine to form the reference smile.
